name: orbisyn
description: Self-hostable ecosystem manager for open-source software: resolve any upstream source into one canonical app record.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @orbisyn/gateway && npm run build --workspace @orbisyn/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.selfhost: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
